steps.explanation: Editing the custom instructions file changes the system prompt, which sits right after the tool definitions. The match breaks there, and all earlier conversation, though unchanged, can no longer match either, because a prefix match cannot skip a changed block and resume later. Only the tool definitions ahead of the change can still be read, and only if a breakpoint caches them alone. A new cache is then written under the updated instructions.

steps.explanation: Normal turn on the post-edit baseline: the cache rebuilds under the updated instructions.
